proposedCapabilities.spec: Condition { type: "destroyedByBattleDamage", target?: TargetRef (default "source") } — true only inside a cardDestroyed triggered ability when the lethal damage instance that caused the destruction was battle damage (damage inflicted through the battle-resolution steps; CR §408.6/§408.8). Requires the cardDestroyed event (or the internal destroy record it is built from) to carry a byBattleDamage boolean, set by inflictLockedBattleDamage when its summed per-speed-group assignment pushes a character to/over its life. Compose with sourceIsEventCard for 'when this card is destroyed by battle damage, ...'.
proposedCapabilities.why: cardDestroyed carries only {cardId, controllerId} — no damage source/type. battleActive/inBattle are unreliable proxies: a mid-battle tactic or ability also kills during a battle (would wrongly trigger 'discard their hand'), and CR §302.15 prunes the card from the battle the instant it dies so inBattle(source) is racy. This 'destroyed by battle damage' cycle recurs across 1st Ed Part 2.

notes: Only gap is 'by battle damage' detection. 'discards their hand' = move every hand card to discard (count == current hand size, one group event).
